semantics.resumeMeaning: Fresh Microsoft discovery and current-state reconciliation. A prior Graph mutation is never replayed from the journal.

dispositions.name: PreserveCommitted
dispositions.behavior: Preserve the committed outcome and verify through fresh discovery/current state.

dispositions.name: PreserveSkipped
dispositions.behavior: No prior tenant write is assumed; current planning decides whether work is still needed.

dispositions.name: SafeToReplan
dispositions.behavior: Only planning/precheck activity was recorded. Replan after fresh discovery.

dispositions.name: ReconcileFailed
dispositions.behavior: Do not replay. Rediscover Microsoft state and reconcile any side effect that may have occurred before failure.

dispositions.name: ReconcileUncertainWrite
dispositions.behavior: A write may have reached Microsoft without a terminal transaction marker. Explicit reconciliation approval is required.

dispositions.name: ReconcileUncertainRollback
dispositions.behavior: Rollback began without a validated terminal marker. Rediscover and reconcile; never replay the rollback body.

dispositions.name: JournalInvalid
dispositions.behavior: Stop. The journal is malformed or contradictory and must be reviewed before another tenant build.
